message: Gecko Multi-Process Architecture: Never force single-process Gecko (dom.ipc.processCount: 1) or disable Fission in Camoufox. YouTube Polymer 3 custom elements choke under single-process IPC queues, causing infinite loading skeletons on comments.

Dynamic YouTube Reply Action Selectors: Accounts without an existing channel render an anchor tag with href=/create_channel instead of a button inside #reply-button-end. Structural selector #reply-button-end :is(button, a) is required to trigger reply actions atomically.

Multi-Lingual YouTube UI Handling: Evidence from Kyrgyz locale (Жооп for Reply, Канал түзүү for Create Channel) proves text-based locators catastrophically fail across non-major languages. Structural IDs (#reply-button-end, ytd-channel-creation-dialog-renderer) guarantee deterministic execution in any locale.

In-Situ Channel Creation Flow: Clicking create_channel anchor opens ytd-channel-creation-dialog-renderer modal. _confirm_channel_creation handles clicking #create-channel-button button and waits for modal hidden state before proceeding with comment typing.

Google Authenticator State Machine: Implemented Material 3 non-error string filtering on [role=alert] and [aria-live=assertive], RFC 6238 TOTP window safety (<2s rollover delay and window wait on retry), and DECLINE_BUTTONS (Cancel, Not now) dismissal to avoid native Windows Hello passkey prompts.

Windows DPAPI Secret Storage: All account passwords and TOTP secrets stored in SQLite are encrypted with Windows DPAPI (CryptProtectData) using current-user scope, preventing credential exposure if the database file is copied or leaked.

Anti-Fraud & Network Safety: SOCKS5 proxies must force network.proxy.socks_remote_dns to true to avoid local DNS leakage. WebRTC is masked by Camoufox, and persistent device fingerprints are pinned per session to avoid suspicious identity rotation.
Adding geo_country schema column and auto-detection via Google Terms endpoint upon successful auth
Camoufox/Firefox cookies.sqlite stores expiry in microseconds/milliseconds (e.g. 1828036010538); normalize timestamp by dividing by 1000 if > 1e11
Lightweight YouTube heartbeat via curl_cffi requires filtering moz_cookies specifically for host LIKE '%.youtube.com' so Google.com cookies do not overwrite YouTube-specific SID/HSID/SSID
Implemented 4-day Account Lifecycle & Aging Engine with automatic quarantine and organic warm-up
Adopted Firefox-consistent session heartbeat and log-normal typing cadences

Warm-up: empty home feed falls back to a neutral search because YouTube retired /feed/trending (July 2025); background warm-up takes the account runner lock and drops its open browser. Merged master: heartbeat uses master's fingerprint_headers (firefox155, UA rewritten to installed Camoufox) instead of the pinned-UA/firefox135 builder.
